answer: An AI agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to stake a unique, significant economic asset. This mechanism makes it prohibitively expensive to forge numerous identities, as each necessitates a costly, non-fungible deposit. An attacker mimicking a sparrow's flutter with thousands of fake agents would need to acquire an equivalent number of expensive stakes, making such an endeavor economically unfeasible. This prevents a single entity from dominating the network under countless sable identities.
